scope: Additional exchange, DSP and mediation protocol surfaces. Distinct exchanges are counted separately from directional profiles.
method: Current primary vendor documentation and official producer artifacts only. Prebid adapter payloads do not prove full exchange acceptance. Searches without retrieved evidence are explicitly deferred.
completeness: This is a public-evidence discovery inventory, not a complete specification certification or acceptance guarantee.

candidates.name: Index Exchange
additional_checkable_constraints: Inbound seller request requires device.ip or device.ipv6.
Inbound site requires domain or page.
DSP bids require adm; paired multi-size banner format requests require bid.w and bid.h.
Outgoing video requires minduration, maxduration and protocols beyond generic 2.6 optional fields.
Multiple video impressions in the seller request must share one supplied podid, with malformed or ambiguous references deferred.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Do not merge seller and DSP directional contracts.
Price units may be configured as cents; account settings cannot be inferred.
Secure creative acceptance needs actual rendered resources, not a textual URL scan.

candidates.name: DV360
additional_checkable_constraints: Request device and user objects are required; empty observed objects are legitimate unknown data.
BidRequest.at=3 is documented beyond the generic 1/2 auction enum.
Video requires a nonempty protocols list.
Sound-off playback values conflict with in-stream placement; plcmt takes precedence over placement.
disable_gma_format is forbidden without gdemsignals.
Only one of the documented mainline/extension privacy signal locations is expected.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Supply chain is required in almost all cases, so missing chain needs a qualified finding.
Currency allowlists and account integration defaults are unavailable.
Response id=0 and missing cur are documented parse-error exceptions.
Protobuf beta and remote ads.txt/schain decisions are outside JSON-only validation.

candidates.name: Unity Exchange
additional_checkable_constraints: Response cur and SeatBid.seat are explicitly required.
Bid price must be positive and accepts at most three decimal places.
Response adomain/crid and documented markup/notification requirements add exchange-specific constraints.
Notification alternatives depend on burl, nurl and impression-tracker availability; read full table before implementation.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Currency is configured per adsource, not USD-only.
Request attributes are sent when available unless the description says otherwise.
A prose seatbid selection note uses bid.id where impid is expected; do not enforce the likely typo.
Latency, creative playback, partner exchange rate and endpoint transport require external evidence.

candidates.name: Vungle Exchange / Liftoff Monetize
additional_checkable_constraints: App and device are always passed in Vungle requests.
Video delivery, minbitrate, maxbitrate, protocols, boxingallowed and playbackmethod are always passed.
Documented extension schemas and response requirements are substantial enough for a real profile.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Use current guide dated August 19, 2026, not old copied schemas.
SKAdNetwork opt-in, network registration, SDK version and creative format context affect conditional requirements.
Do not equate producer always-passed fields with supply integration requirements.

candidates.name: InMobi
additional_checkable_constraints: Inbound publisher request requires imp.tagid or imp.ext.placementid.
Inbound publisher integration currently requires app and device and documents in-app-only support.
There are complete direction-specific request/response tables for DSP integration.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Do not apply inbound placement IDs to outgoing buyer traffic.
Placement existence, cookie synchronization, gzip and HTTP status require context not present in a JSON value.
Native and privacy-dependent capabilities require their actual integration context.

candidates.name: BidSwitch
additional_checkable_constraints: Outgoing buyer request requires device, user, tmax, cur and ext; empty user is explicitly valid after privacy opt-out.
Supplier request device is required, but user/tmax/cur are optional.
Response banner adm is required and permits at most one win-price macro.
Video response protocol is required, and markup comes through video-specific extensions.
wseat takes precedence over bseat, unlike a generic conjunctive seat restriction check.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Supplier page introductory site/app requirement conflicts with its later DOOH support, so keep DOOH valid.
5.x protocol extension, s2s notification settings and supplier-specific optional fields need their documented conditions.
Supplier compatibility, prices, agency mapping, HTTP callbacks and remote approval are external.

candidates.name: Sovrn
additional_checkable_constraints: Imp.tagid is required.
Banner w/h are marked required, although format description also gives an alternate size path.
Video minduration/maxduration/w/h are required.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Current article exposes request tables only; no stronger response contract substantiated.
Banner format alternative must avoid rejecting documented format-only inputs without resolving prose.
Do not enforce article typos declaring protocols or schain as scalars against canonical OpenRTB.

candidates.name: Digital Turbine Exchange / Fyber
versions: 2.2/2.3/2.5 public support list; complete current 2.5 guide, fixture compatibility under 2.5/latest 2.6
additional_checkable_constraints: request producer object and field presence, including present User consent and PMP private_auction
supply-chain recursive typing and required members
extended identifier recursive typing
GPP and legacy regulatory extension typing
SDK app/device/user/impression extensions, documented ranges and compatible boolean alternatives
banner/video producer fields and values
direct-object and canonical-request-string Native decoded field types and producer constants
Native required-asset response pairing
response metadata and USD
auction-price macro carriers and minimum-to-win context
SKAdNetwork request/response nested fields, campaign/source identifier bounds, UUIDs, decimal timestamps and fidelity
exact null SKAdNetwork network-list request alternative
SKOverlay flags and delay ranges
AutoStore and dual-end-card store ID conditions, strict DSP-dual boolean
display click tracker requirement only when feature and click firing explicitly enabled
paired SKAdNetwork source/network/version agreement, matching impression deals and rewarded playable attribution
unknown extensions and creative-type strings remain open
conflicting presence claims stay warnings
documented_or_evidence_gaps: signature cryptographic validity
actual tracking execution and position inside markup
SDK runtime eligibility and delivery
account feature enablement and seller/buyer configuration
jurisdiction and publisher privacy availability
HTTP compression and transport
creative content and advertiser policy
unsupported future keys explicitly ignored; no closed inferred creative acceptance enum
geo.dma type unspecified
Conflicting mandatory/optional source labels generate warnings, not rejection.
Source-specific Native placement typos and boolean ambiguity are retained with narrow compatibility.

implementation.public_source_status: Current full public 2.5 guide retrieved and pinned; acceptance remains scoped to locally checkable semantics.

candidates.name: Criteo Commerce Grid
additional_checkable_constraints: Device, user and cur required.
Imp.instl required.
App/video impressions require displaymanager and displaymanagerver.
In-app imp.clickbrowser and app.bundle required.
Banner.format plus banner.w/h required.
Metric.vendor required.
Native privacy must be 1.
Device ua/geo/dnt/lmt/ip required in this documented integration.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Network ID can be in the URL or payload, so JSON-only omission must defer.
gpid is simultaneously recommended and mandatory in one row.
Native payload location/encoding alternatives and legacy/schema typos need compatibility handling.
Account inventory mapping, privacy jurisdiction and response fields on separate steps are unreviewed.

candidates.name: AppLovin Exchange ALX
additional_checkable_constraints: DSP bids require adm, adomain, burl, cat and crid.
Response currency accepts only USD, defaulting to USD.
Advertiser domain cannot contain HTTP scheme or slash.
SKAdNetwork requires bundle and matching itunesitem; campaign bounds are version-dependent.
Supplied seat has a 40-character alphanumeric limit.
CTV duration and HTML+SKAdNetwork clicktrackers have explicit conditional requirements.
Native request and response carriers reject malformed encoded JSON and preserve canonical carrier boundaries across all accepted encodings.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: SDK bidders are exempt from mandatory adm, so profile must expressly mean DSP integration.
4 KB raw response limit requires input byte length, not compact reserialization.
Markup URL-encoding prose conflicts with official examples; do not over-enforce.
Creative crtype can be preconfigured on account, so absence is not universally an error.

candidates.name: MobileFuse
additional_checkable_constraints: In-app request requires app/device, app.bundle and imp.tagid.
Only the first imp is processed; additional imps ignored.
Supplied tmax must be at least 100.
badv supports at most 50 entries.
Native request supports object or JSON-string encoding and version 1.2.
Separate SDK mediation contract requires first user data segment signal and first imp.tagid.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: App-only requirement does not describe separate web Prebid or TAM pathways.
Do not require SDK signal token on ordinary S2S requests.
Endpoint SSP partner ID and token rendering need context.
DSP acceptance and downstream support differ by demand partner.

candidates.name: Equativ / Smart
additional_checkable_constraints: Inbound Site.domain required.
Publisher network account ID has a documented integer type.
Optional extension fields have typed schemas suitable for validation.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Network ID has an alternate authentication transport; missing publisher.id cannot be unconditionally rejected.
Inbound API tables and outbound DSP contracts are separate.
Supported fields page references a downloadable mapping that needs complete review.

candidates.name: FreeWheel
additional_checkable_constraints: Producer table always passes test/tmax/cur/regs.
Video w/h and protocols are always passed.
Deal.at=3 is documented fixed price.
Optional device ext.atts enum is explicitly 0 to 3.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Always-passed describes outgoing producer behavior, not inbound acceptance.
tmax 200 applies unconditionally only to documented guaranteed requests.
Transport, enabled schain, creative review and account DSP version require context.
One wseat row incorrectly says bid response, so avoid inferred response mandates.
Current substantive response guide could not be retrieved; canonical page presents access challenge.
Cached producer table and configured-version behavior do not prove a complete current acceptance profile.

candidates.name: TripleLift
additional_checkable_constraints: Placement tagid, banner format, recursively typed Native 1.2 request and response fields.
Canonical native media, script tracker markup, tracker event/method membership and required tracker fields.
Paired remote asset support and event/method negotiation with malformed reference deferral.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Supplier scope only. Current migration tables supersede historical native-only and fixed-ID restrictions.
Conflicting banner-format requiredness versus supported width/height fallback is a warning.
Account authentication and optional identifiers require external context; response data.vasttag row is a likely table-copy error.

candidates.name: Yandex Open Bidding
additional_checkable_constraints: App.bundle required.
Response signaldata is explicitly required to return to client.
Documented single SeatBid and single bid response shape.
Bidder token and SDK-rendered response distinguish this contract from a generic DSP.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Server endpoint and SDK/client context are integration-specific.
Do not use this Android Open Bidding page as full Yandex DSP/SSP protocol.
Some media field descriptions contain obvious copy errors.

candidates.name: Yahoo DSP / ConnectID
additional_checkable_constraints: Conditional Yahoo ConnectID eids use source yahoo.com, nonempty uids and UID id; eids location depends on version.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: The official ConnectID optional identity guide documents OpenRTB 2.5 extension and 2.6 standard EID paths, but not a full Yahoo exchange request and response contract.
The direct exchange acceptance contract remains unverified in retrieved primary evidence.

candidates.name: Adform OpenRTB Handler
additional_checkable_constraints: Supplied ext.pt string has a net-price default.
Optional DSA extension has explicit typed enum contracts.
0.0.0.0 IP disables header fallback in this handler.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Handler is a particular integration surface, not all Adform DSP or exchange traffic.
Video constraints come from account UI and unsupported fields may be ignored.
Most advertised required rules duplicate core OpenRTB; no generic-only profile.

candidates.name: Smaato / Verve Brand+
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Smaato 2.6 endpoint redirects to the current Verve Brand+ specification.
Retrieved tables mostly restate generic OpenRTB. Unsupported fields are ignored or passed through, not universally rejected.
No substantive additional acceptance rule established. Do not pad coverage with a generic-only profile.
Legacy Smaato 2.5 and specific native/SDK extensions could support a separately named future contract after complete review.

candidates.name: OpenX
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Official navigation names current supplier and buyer OpenRTB tables.
GET requests to 35 direct protocol routes followed OAuth/login and returned 1,381-byte application shells. The substantive tables were not retrieved.
Navigation and producer adapters do not establish exchange acceptance rules.

candidates.name: PubMatic
additional_checkable_constraints: Recursive custom wire objects, arrays, bidder maps, boolean types and signed integer widths.
The selected CTV endpoint requires video and validates explicit per-impression adpod after count defaults of 1 and 3.
The CTV supply-chain helper drops invalid chains, producing a profile warning.
documented_or_evidence_gaps: PubMatic exchange acceptance is separate from OpenWrap producer middleware. Detailed exchange support documentation requires login.
The raw stage does not prove normalized PBS bidder configuration. Account-derived placement, consent and stored settings remain unknown.
CTV aggregate responses do not prove a simple per-bid duration or count cap.

candidates.name: Amazon APS / TAM / UAM
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Public product information does not expose a complete demand partner OpenRTB schema. Partner-specific SDK or bidder bridge documentation is not APS acceptance evidence.

candidates.name: The Trade Desk
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Public API/partner surfaces were located, but a full direct OpenRTB acceptance specification was not retrieved. UID2 evidence does not establish exchange-wide mandatory fields.

candidates.name: Microsoft Ad Exchange
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Current documented Microsoft Monetize surface is existing Xandr. Do not count a rename as another exchange or infer a separate Microsoft contract.

candidates.name: Magnite Streaming / SpringServe
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Public SpringServe bidder guide confirms 2.5, endpoint regions and cookie synchronization but lacks substantive extra payload requirements. It is not the existing DV+ xAPI protocol.

candidates.name: Beachfront
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Public full bid request/response protocol not retrieved. Search did not substantiate extra field constraints.

candidates.name: Sharethrough
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Public creative/DCO FAQs refer to Native 1.2 and tracker limits. They do not provide a full OpenRTB payload contract.

candidates.name: Moloco
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Targeted current primary-source review retrieved campaign, measurement and app-ads.txt policy material, but no substantive direct OpenRTB request/response acceptance contract. This does not prove the vendor has no specification.

candidates.name: BidsData
documented_or_evidence_gaps: No unambiguous official protocol source found under this name. Do not invent a profile or conflate with BidSwitch/BidData.

candidates.name: RTB House
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Official SDA discussion exists, but no additional full direct protocol acceptance contract was retrieved. Prebid adapter is insufficient.

candidates.name: Media.net
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Official policy requires respecting requests, and a generic OpenRTB converter exists. Neither defines substantive vendor-specific payload constraints.

candidates.name: Samsung Ads
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Public CTV/product statements discuss 2.6 integration but no full Samsung-specific direct protocol was retrieved. Do not assume Publica implementation is Samsung acceptance contract.

candidates.name: Nexxen
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Public product/job information confirms OpenRTB integration, but no complete official field specification was retrieved. Legacy Tremor/Unruly surfaces need explicit current compatibility evidence.

candidates.name: AdColony
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Legacy AdColony protocol should not be conflated with DT Exchange. No current separate extra OpenRTB schema retrieved.

candidates.name: BIGO Ads
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Official developer docs expose SDK and reporting. No public direct OpenRTB acceptance specification retrieved.

candidates.name: Mintegral
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Official advertiser tracking and SDK material does not define direct OpenRTB. No full extra contract retrieved.

candidates.name: Pangle
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Public mediation guides and Prebid parameters are not a full direct OpenRTB specification. No additional acceptance rules substantiated.

candidates.name: LoopMe
documented_or_evidence_gaps: Official legal materials mention OpenRTB roles, without an extra field-level integration contract.

replay_count_method: Counts include case records in all checked-in exchange-depth cases.json, cases.jsonl and manifest.json corpora. Primary fixture counts remain separate; reference and peer-review controls are included only in all-replay counts.

final_scope_summary.scope_limit: Scoped primary public contracts and locally checkable semantics. Fixture records are not percentages of exchange acceptance or a complete certification. Public access deferrals describe retrieved evidence, not absence of a vendor specification. PubMatic OpenWrap producer contracts do not certify full PubMatic exchange acceptance.
final_scope_summary.release_status: Local candidate. No RTBLint publication or deployment.
